thread:
alex: Heads-up 10am PT kickoff Monday for Zenith pilot. Customer expects a four-week engagement but wants a very clear success checklist and a short SE office-hours cadence. Need to confirm SE coverage, acceptance metrics, and whether they require VPC/private deploy. Also pricing discussion at handoff.

dana: I can take point on SE support. Ill do Tue mornings and Fri afternoons for office hours (PST). Prefer concrete eval prompts + a retrieval test set to size caching and batch configs.

ravi: Draft success criteria proposal: (1) 90%+ extraction accuracy on 500 key extraction prompts; (2) end-to-end 95p latency <350ms for 128-token responses under steady-state 20 concurrent users; (3) no data exfiltration incidents; (4) documented handoff with runbook.

dana: Suggest micro-evals: named-entity exact match, slot-filling F1, and semantic retrieval MRR. We should run baseline on Day 2 and then after tuning Week 2 to measure delta.

alex: Customer confirmed no PHI in dataset. They prefer US East for data residency. They asked if we can demo an A/B test between quantized and fp16 model variants.

leah: Security checklist: need completed security-questionnaire, clarification on S3 access roles, KMS key ownership, and whether they want VPC peering or Private deployment. I need the questionnaire back by Wed EOD to avoid delaying the network setup.

deploy-bot: Deployment note: when VPC peering requested, please include CIDR ranges and expected egress rules. See playbook: https://internal/runbooks/pilot-networking

ravi: Proposed timeline (compact):
Week 0 (Kickoff): share dataset + credentials, agree success gates, security questionnaire in flight
Week 1: index + baseline micro-evals, initial prompt set v1, SE office hours start
Week 2: tuning (prompt engineering + quant), perf runs (latency/concurrency), A/B evals
Week 3: regression sweep, acceptance review with customer, runbook draft
Week 4: final acceptance demo, pricing handoff, retention of artifacts + handoff docs

dana: Owner list: infra & access customer + eng-oncall; SE tuning & evals dana; acceptance metrics & demo ravi; security sign-off leah; AE coordination alex.

leah: Clarify: if they want VPC peering we require a minimum 5 business days for network approvals. If they take Hosted with VPC, we still need completed IAC.

alex: Pricing note: for demos we cover hosting; production pricing TBD based on reserved capacity requests. We'll recap at final demo.

dana: SE hours confirmed: Tue 90011am PST and Fri 2004pm PST weekly. I can also hop on async Slack for urgent issues.

ravi: Can we lock success gates and resource rosters by Friday EOD? Ill produce the pilot playbook and share a calendar for SE office hours.

alex: I'll circulate the prompt bank + a short customer primer today. Please react with :white_check_mark: if aligned or flag blockers.

dana: :white_check_mark: aligned.

leah: :+1: I'll upload the questionnaire and next steps.

ravi: :white_check_mark: adding milestones to the playbook.

alex: Great thanks all follow-up sync Fri 3pm PT after internal review.
